notes.title: Check out my new steam game Age of the Duel!
notes.content:
Age of the Duel is a game where you duel your friends in multiple ages! Become the best Duelist or simply spectate and place bets on who will win. 

The game also includes a game mode that uses a similar movement mechanic to Speed Swing, but is a first person shooter, where the objective is to either shoot the opponent or swing around and collect a coin.

notes.title: Speed Swing update 6
notes.content: Added movement hint screen to menu and pause screens.

notes.title: Speed Swing update 5
notes.content: Fixed lighting on rope. Increased number of spots on the leader board.

notes.title: Speed Swing update 4
notes.content: Added the ability to retry a level after completion. Added the number of attempts a level took before completing. Added Graphics option to the in-game pause menu.

notes.title: Speed Swing update 3
notes.content: Made leader board more robust. Increased maximum grapple length. Reopen the leader board for your score to show up again.

notes.title: Speed Swing update 2
notes.content: Fixed leaderboard not working with certain names, and improved shadows on most maps.

notes.title: Speed Swing update 1
notes.content: Fixed some bugs and made some map adjustments. I reset the times of completions before the patch, but have not changed level progress.
